title: A new look at an old dog: Bonn-Oberkassel reconsidered

passages.quote: Four radiocarbon dates were performed on the canine bones (for details see Table 3), situating them between ca. 12900/12850 and ca. 11900/11850 cal BC. Their weighted mean is between 12290 and 12050 cal BC
These two late Pleistocene Bonn-Oberkassel dogs provide some of the oldest undisputed evidence for domestic dogs.
